identity.title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][prune] Resolve issue-local terminal worktree topology safely

values.task_boundary: Replace suffix matching with exact repository-rooted canonical topology matching and prove fail-closed behavior.
deliverables: Canonical resolver for issue-local, absolute, and clean relative terminal worktree identities
Exact branch, current-root, and live-worktree tuple guard
Focused sentinel, collision, traversal, missing, wrong-checkout, dirty, and receipt-stability regressions
Typed validation, review, publication, merge, and terminal receipt
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: `.` resolves to the canonical current issue worktree and passes only for an exact branch and live topology match
AC-2: clean relative worktrees resolve from the primary repository root and absolute worktrees require exact canonical identity
AC-3: empty, missing, traversal-bearing, wrong-branch, wrong-checkout, suffix-collision, and dirty candidates return unsafe_checkout
AC-4: validate-prune leaves retained terminal receipt bytes unchanged
AC-5: a #5340-equivalent closed-out terminal record validates without changing #5340 state or receipt
AC-6: focused Rust tests, strict Clippy, exact-revision review, hosted checks, post-merge validation, and typed closeout pass
dependencies: Issue 5340 terminal evidence as read-only defect provenance
Existing typed C-SDLC v2 binding and Git worktree topology semantics
repo_inputs: Rust standard library and existing tempfile test dependency
non_goals: No terminal schema or record migration
No manual prune bypass or clean-worktree weakening
No Runtime, AWS, provider, or unrelated milestone work
